description: R0-35-EXIT-PROOF binds R0-14-AUTH-LOCAL-SIGNIN's suites: identity-local-auth.integration.test.ts (created by its repair f6554848, extended by R0-SEC-01-BOOTSTRAP-TAKEOVER and R0-SEC-02-VERIFYLOCAL-ISSUER) and the three specs R0-SEC-02-VERIFYLOCAL-ISSUER created (supabase-auth.service.spec.ts and env.spec.ts at 580f2f2c, supabase-auth.service.provider.spec.ts at 93402a4d). The queue planned this manifest under this name; it was never added, so R0-35 adds it. Every case that passed at the R0-35 head is required (118 cases); allowAdditionalCases is true so a later packet may add a case without editing this manifest, while a required case that is renamed, skipped, turned into a todo or deleted rejects the verdict, and a new skip or todo fails release0-proof-coverage.spec.ts until scripts/proof-admission/release0-index.json explains it. Run from the repo root: node scripts/proof-admission/run-manifests.mjs --only identity-local-auth.json (or pnpm --filter server proof:release0 for every Release 0 manifest), against a migrated isolated database and REDIS_URL.
